_comment: Cluster paths for the whole-TCGA from_file rerun. Every path the jobs need is here; nothing is hardcoded in the scripts. Any value may be overridden at submit time with an environment variable of the same name upper-cased, e.g. WORK_ROOT=/somewhere/else.
_gzip_intermediates: Write filtered/ and filtered_wgermline/ as .gz. Everything downstream reads .gz transparently.
_delete_filtered_after_germline: Remove a sample's filtered/ file once it has been converted, so only filtered_wgermline/ and msmutect_results/ persist.
